card.summary: No free tier of the batch features is priced on the page; the three paid tiers are ¥25/月, ¥30/月 and ¥360 永久.

record.category: batch transfer / share tool for Chinese pans

free_tier.stated: No free tier of the batch features is priced on the page; the three paid tiers are ¥25/月, ¥30/月 and ¥360 永久.

per_object_cap.stated: Not applicable: it drives the pan's own transfer, so the pan's cap applies.

retention.stated: Not applicable: nothing is stored by the tool.

egress.terms: No traffic of its own: transfers happen between the pan and the destination account, and downloads consume the pan's own quota.

record.interface_detail: Windows and macOS desktop application. Credentials are stored encrypted locally; there is no server-side API.
record.tooling: Desktop app for 夸克, 百度 and 迅雷: 批量转存, 批量重命名, 批量分享, 链接转换, 自动同步.
record.chaining: The automation layer for 代下 at scale: when the route is 'save the share, then retrieve', this is the tool that turns a thousand share links into a thousand saved files.

limits.value: batch 转存 needs the pan account's cookie, pasted into the app
not published; the pan's own rate limit applies

identity_cost.detail: Licence bought by 支付宝 QR; the account is local to the app. The gate is payment plus a pan account, which is the +86 wall.

record.reliability_note: It stores pan cookies locally, so a pan that rotates its endpoints breaks the tool until it is updated - the same fragility as every cookie-driven client.
record.confidence_note: All three prices and the feature matrix were read off the vendor page. No transfer was run.

evidence.proved: VIP1 ¥25/月, VIP2 ¥30/月, 专业版永久 ¥360; '夸克 / 百度 / 迅雷三大网盘'; 批量转存/重命名/分享/链接转换/自动同步; 支付宝付款

record.notes: Priced per month for a batch tool, which only pays off when many shares are moved. For a single 1 TiB pull it is pure overhead.
record.binding_note: Nothing in this tool meters bytes; what gates it is the pan cookie it must hold, so the pan's identity wall is inherited and named here.
